metadata.description: Device posture workbook for the platform's DeviceSecurity_CL table in Microsoft Sentinel.
Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel and the DeviceSecurity_CL table (same resource group).

{"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"content":{"json":"## Device security posture
Devices, vulnerability findings and audit activity sent by the platform to the `DeviceSecurity_CL` table. Device and finding panels show the latest state per device and per finding within the selected time range."},"name":"intro"},{"type":9,"content":{"version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","parameters":[{"id":"6f1d2c1e-4b52-4d59-9d0a-5b9e3c1f7a10","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"TimeRange","label":"Time range","type":4,"isRequired":true,"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":1209600000},{"durationMs":2592000000},{"durationMs":7776000000}],"allowCustom":true}}],"style":"pills","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"},"name":"parameters"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"let devices = DeviceSecurity_CL | where isnotempty(DeviceUid) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceMac, DeviceRiskScore, DeviceGroups, DeviceFirstSeen) by SourceTenant, DeviceUid;
let findings = DeviceSecurity_CL | where ClassUid == 2002 | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, SeverityId, CveId, CvssScore, IsExploitAvailable, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceGroups) by SourceTenant, FindingUid, DeviceUid | where Status != "Resolved" and Status != "Suppressed";
union
 (devices | summarize Value = dcount(DeviceUid) | extend Metric = "Devices"),
 (devices | where tostring(DeviceGroups) has "Quarantined" | summarize Value = dcount(DeviceUid) | extend Metric = "Quarantined devices"),
 (findings | where SeverityId == 5 | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "Open critical findings"),
 (findings | where IsExploitAvailable == true | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "Open known-exploited findings")
| project Metric, Value","size":4,"title":"Overview","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","visualization":"tiles","tileSettings":{"titleContent":{"columnMatch":"Metric","formatter":1},"leftContent":{"columnMatch":"Value","formatter":12,"formatOptions":{"palette":"auto"}},"showBorder":false}},"name":"tiles"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"DeviceSecurity_CL | where ClassUid == 2002 | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, SeverityId, CveId, CvssScore, IsExploitAvailable, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceGroups) by SourceTenant, FindingUid, DeviceUid | where Status != "Resolved" and Status != "Suppressed"
| summarize Findings = count() by Severity = case(SeverityId == 5, "Critical", SeverityId == 4, "High", SeverityId == 3, "Medium", SeverityId == 2, "Low", "Unknown")","size":1,"title":"Open findings by severity","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","visualization":"piechart"},"name":"findings_by_severity","customWidth":"50"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"DeviceSecurity_CL | where isnotempty(DeviceUid) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceMac, DeviceRiskScore, DeviceGroups, DeviceFirstSeen) by SourceTenant, DeviceUid
| summarize Devices = count() by Band = case(isnull(DeviceRiskScore), "Unscored", DeviceRiskScore < 4, "0-4", DeviceRiskScore < 7, "4-7", DeviceRiskScore < 9, "7-9", "9-10")
| order by Band asc","size":1,"title":"Devices by risk score band","timeContextFromParameter":"TimeRange","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","visualization":"barchart"},"name":"risk_distribution","customWidth":"50"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"DeviceSecurity_CL | where isnotempty(DeviceUid) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceMac, DeviceRiskScore, DeviceGroups, DeviceFirstSeen) by SourceTenant, DeviceUid

| order by DeviceRiskScore asc

| where IsExploitAvailable == true
